scope: Noncontrolling public-source corroboration for the four SIGE insular rows that remain canonically unresolved after frozen GNIS/SIGE candidate expansion

rules.external_sources: corroboration only unless an explicit stable crosswalk or hard geometry/lineage binding is recovered
rules.temporal_caution: older plans/reports can corroborate names and places but cannot independently certify present-day identity/status

external_evidence.authority: Puerto Rico Department of Natural and Environmental Resources (DRNA)
external_evidence.evidence: DRNA zoning-maritime-boundary notice explicitly identifies Cayo de Ratones in the Municipality of Salinas.

rows.reason: Singular/plural and individual-vs-group semantics remain; no explicit SIGE↔GNIS stable-ID crosswalk or hard geometry binding recovered.

external_evidence.authority: Puerto Rico / Roosevelt Roads master-plan publication
external_evidence.evidence: The master-plan map labels Cabeza de Perros in the Roosevelt Roads/Ceiba coastal area.

rows.reason: Three separate current GNIS stable IDs occupy the same small Ceiba area; external map labeling does not select one stable GNIS identity.

external_evidence.authority: University of Puerto Rico at Mayagüez, Department of Marine Sciences
external_evidence.evidence: UPRM identifies Isla Magueyes at La Parguera on the coast of Lajas and gives the Isla Magueyes laboratory address.

rows.reason: The evidence strongly supports Magueyes as the local island name, but no source explicitly states SIGE 'Maguelles' is a typo/variant of GNIS Feature ID 1611186.

external_evidence.authority: Puerto Rico Department of Natural and Environmental Resources (DRNA)
external_evidence.evidence: DRNA report describes Caña Gorda Reef and states it is also known as Cayo de Caña Gorda in the Guánica Reserve.

rows.reason: DRNA treats the named feature as a reef while GNIS source taxonomy is Island/Cayos; the mismatch must remain explicit rather than being normalized away.
